# API地址列表

**iTick** 提供全面的 API 套件，包括 FIX、REST 和 Websocket API，可满足机构级客户的需求。我们的 iTick API 解决方案具有高度可扩展性，可让客户访问实时市场数据和见解。客户可以轻松地将我们的 iTick API 与其现有系统和应用程序集成，从而简化工作流程

## 免费体验API地址

| 产品     | REST API                           | Websocket API                    | FIX API |
| -------- | ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------- |
| 加密货币 | https://api-free.itick.org/crypto  | wss://api-free.itick.org/crypto  |         |
| 外汇     | https://api-free.itick.org/forex   | wss://api-free.itick.org/forex   |         |
| 指数     | https://api-free.itick.org/indices | wss://api-free.itick.org/indices |         |
| 股票     | https://api-free.itick.org/stock   | wss://api-free.itick.org/stock   |         |
| 期货     | https://api-free.itick.org/future  | wss://api-free.itick.org/future  |         |
| 基金     | https://api-free.itick.org/fund    | wss://api-free.itick.org/fund    |         |
